newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.5 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 50 billion dong ($4.46 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.50 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on February 19, the central bank sold 10 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 10.99 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday was February 28 and maturity will be on February 28, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 45.2 billion
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 3.0 billion
Saigon Commercial Joint Stock Bank 1.8 billion
